definitions.gloss: to dawn; to grow light; to break (of day)
definitions.explanation: Describes the sky gradually becoming lighter as dawn approaches. A literary and evocative word that conveys the slow, whitening spread of light before sunrise.

examples.japanese: {東|ひがし}の{空|そら}が{白々|しらじら}と{明|あ}けてきた。
examples.english: The eastern sky began to grow light.

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}を{徹|てっ}して{話|はな}しているうちに、{空|そら}が{白々|しらじら}と{明|あ}けた。
examples.english: While we talked through the night, the sky gradually grew light.

examples.japanese: {白々|しらじら}と{明|あ}ける{空|そら}の{下|した}、{漁師|りょうし}たちはすでに{船|ふね}を{出|だ}していた。
examples.english: Under the brightening dawn sky, the fishermen had already set out in their boats.

notes:
Composed of {白々|しらじら} (whitish, pale) and {明|あ}ける (to open/dawn). A literary expression that paints the visual scene of the sky turning pale before sunrise. Often used in the pattern {白々|しらじら}と{明|あ}ける, where と marks the manner of the dawning.

USAGE:
This word belongs to literary and poetic registers. In everyday speech, {夜|よ}が{明|あ}ける (dawn breaks) or {朝|あさ}になる (it becomes morning) is far more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空|そら}が{白々|しらじら}と{明|あ}ける: the sky grows pale with dawn
- {白々|しらじら}{明|あ}けの{空|そら}: the brightening dawn sky

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {夜明|よあ}け: dawn/daybreak — the standard neutral term
- {明|あ}け{方|がた}: early dawn — refers to the time period
- {東雲|しののめ}: dawn (literary) — classical/poetic synonym
